author: jalmena
tagline: Because "I think it was smaller" is not data.
description:
Self-hosted longitudinal tracking of your moles and skin marks: register them on a body map, photograph them
periodically against a physical reference, measure them with their uncertainty, compare observations over time
and take a report to your dermatologist. Your photographs never leave your server.

neVus is a personal documentation and measurement aid. It does not diagnose, screen for, or assess the risk of
any disease.

tips.before_install:
Set PUID and PGID to the owner of /DATA/AppData/nevus/data. For live camera capture and installation as an
app on your phone, serve neVus over HTTPS through your reverse proxy; uploading photos from the native camera
works over plain HTTP.

title: neVus
release_note:
1.4.0: photos taken with the reference card are normalised, flattened onto the card, upright and cropped
to it at a known scale, so every card photo is the same picture and two visits compare at a glance; the
original stays the record. The interface redrawn as one quiet application: an app bar with the way back
and one primary action within the thumb's reach, rows instead of cards, forms in sheets, a rail on the
desktop. Marks on a body map with dated looks and scrubbed photographs; measurement against the card or a
coin with its uncertainty; comparison views and PDF reports for the clinician; reminders by email,
webhook, calendar feed or push notification; full-body sessions; a second factor, encrypted backups and
a trash. English, Spanish and Portuguese.
